bull.summary: Large revenue surprise, >70% expected GM, net cash and analyst-target gap can force revisions.

bear.summary: Shipment timing boosts sequential growth; company remains loss-making, dilution material, coverage sparse, post-release executable price unknown.

challenger.summary: Do not equate revenue surprise with stock upside. Close predates release, so gap risk can consume expected return. Neutralize unavailable insider/congress/options evidence. No prior outcomes means no learned edge.

final.reason: Strong catalyst, but post-close repricing is unknown and council has zero calibrated history; require post-news price/volume confirmation.
